symbols.name: panner
symbols.summary: A simple linear stereo panner. `panner` is a standard Faust function.

params.name: g
params.description: the panning (0-1)

symbols.name: constantPowerPan
symbols.summary: Apply constant-power panning to a stereo signal. Each input channel's gain is adjusted according to the pan position using a cosine/sine law: the left input is scaled by cos(θ)/√2 and the right input by sin(θ)/√2, where θ = π·p/2.

params.name: p
params.description: the panning (0-1)

symbols.name: spat
symbols.summary: GMEM SPAT: n-outputs spatializer. `spat` is a standard Faust function.

params.name: N
params.description: number of outputs (a constant numerical expression)

params.name: r
params.description: rotation (between 0 et 1)

params.name: d
params.description: distance of the source (between 0 et 1)

symbols.name: wfs
symbols.summary: Wave Field Synthesis algorithm for multiple sound sources. Implementation generalized starting from Pierre Lecomte version.
symbols.usage: wfs(xref, yref, zref, speakersDist, nSources, nSpeakers, inProc, xs, ys, zs) : si.bus(nSpeakers)

params.name: xref
params.description: x-coordinate of the reference listening point in meters

params.name: yref
params.description: y-coordinate of the reference listening point in meters

params.name: zref
params.description: z-coordinate of the reference listening point in meters

params.name: speakersDist
params.description: distance between speakers in meters

params.name: nSources
params.description: number of sound sources

params.name: nSpeakers
params.description: number of speakers

params.name: inProc
params.description: per-source processor function, as a function of the source index

params.name: xs
params.description: x-coordinate of the sound source in meters, as a function of the source index

params.name: ys
params.description: y-coordinate of the sound source in meters, as a function of the source index

params.name: zs
params.description: z-coordinate of the sound source in meters, as a function of the source index

io.raw: wfs(xref, yref, zref, speakersDist, nSources, nSpeakers, inProc, xs, ys, zs) : si.bus(nSpeakers)
